Post 1

ASX clawed back 30 points (+0.33%) to 9,083.80 Thursday, but the real story was underneath: Materials ripped +3.52% while Financials cratered -1.93%. A market pulling in two directions at once. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Materials +3.52% and IT +2.54% did the heavy lifting. Financials -1.93% and Consumer Staples -1.17% dragged. Earnings season is splitting the market clean down the middle. #ASX #mining #banking

Post 3

🔺 ZIP surged 18.22% to AUD 3.05 and Super Retail jumped 15.05% to AUD 14.45. Two very different businesses, one shared signal: selective risk appetite is back. #ASX #ausbiz #fintech

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,311.80/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7114. A softer Aussie dollar is amplifying local gold returns — miners are feeling it. Silver at AUD 94.24/oz. #gold #metals #ASX #mining

Post 5

ASX sits 2.29% below its 52-week high and down 1.14% this week. Can Materials hold +3.52% gains if gold fades? Watch AUD/USD 0.71 as the line in the sand. Where do you see the index heading? #ASX #ausbiz
